definition: A person who buys and sells something; a person who gives out cards.
examples: He's a car dealer.
The police arrested a drug dealer.
The dealer gave me two cards.

spanish.definition: Persona que compra y vende algo; persona que reparte las cartas.

definition: A person accused of a crime in a court.
examples: The defendant said he was innocent.
The judge looked at the defendant.
The defendant has a good lawyer.

spanish.definition: Persona acusada de un delito en un tribunal.

definition: Extra help or a copy you keep in case of problems.
examples: The officer called for backup.
Do you have a backup of these photos?
We need a backup plan.

spanish.definition: Ayuda extra o copia que guardas por si hay problemas.

definition: What you say when something hurts.
examples: Ouch! That hurts!
Ouch, I burned my finger!
He said ouch and dropped the pan.

spanish.definition: Lo que dices cuando algo te duele.

definition: Not far away.
examples: Is there a bank nearby?
We ate at a nearby restaurant.
My parents live nearby.

spanish.definition: No muy lejos.

definition: Something good you get; to get something good.
examples: Exercise has many benefits.
This job has great benefits.
Everyone will benefit from the new park.

spanish.definition: Algo bueno que obtienes; obtener algo bueno.

definition: An exciting and unusual experience.
examples: Our trip was a real adventure.
She loves adventure movies.
He told us about his adventures in Africa.

spanish.definition: Experiencia emocionante y poco común.

definition: Land that belongs to a country or an animal.
examples: The soldiers entered enemy territory.
Dogs protect their territory.
This territory belongs to Canada.

spanish.definition: Tierra que pertenece a un país o a un animal.

definition: Words that say you are sorry.
examples: I owe you an apology.
Please accept my apology.
She never got an apology from him.

spanish.definition: Palabras que dicen que lo sientes.

definition: A long tube for water or gas; a thing for smoking.
examples: A water pipe broke in the kitchen.
My grandfather smoked a pipe.
The pipes froze last winter.

spanish.definition: Tubo largo para agua o gas; objeto para fumar.

definition: The color between black and white.
examples: He has gray hair.
It's a cold, gray day.
She was dressed in gray.

spanish.definition: Color entre el negro y el blanco.

definition: Things that are made to be sold.
examples: The store sells sporting goods.
Trucks carry goods across the country.
We sell baked goods on Sundays.

spanish.definition: Cosas hechas para venderse.

definition: A cold dish of vegetables.
examples: I'll have a chicken salad.
Do you want salad with your pizza?
She made a big green salad.

spanish.definition: Plato frío de verduras.

definition: The air around the Earth; the feeling of a place.
examples: The restaurant has a nice atmosphere.
The Earth's atmosphere protects us.
The atmosphere at the game was great.

spanish.definition: Aire que rodea la Tierra; sensación de un lugar.

definition: In or to the center of a city.
examples: I work downtown.
Let's take the bus downtown.
We stayed in a downtown hotel.

spanish.definition: En el centro de una ciudad o hacia él.

definition: Old and bad, not good to eat; very bad.
examples: These apples are rotten.
That was a rotten thing to do.
The smell of rotten eggs filled the room.

spanish.definition: Viejo y malo, no apto para comer; muy malo.

definition: A perfect, beautiful place; heaven.
examples: This beach is paradise.
Hawaii is a paradise for surfers.
It felt like paradise after the long winter.

spanish.definition: Lugar perfecto y hermoso; el cielo.

definition: The time between two events.
examples: Dinner's almost ready. In the meantime, sit down.
The doctor is late, so read a magazine in the meantime.
I'll call you soon. In the meantime, get some rest.

spanish.definition: Tiempo entre dos sucesos.

definition: A group of people who work together for a purpose.
examples: She works for a health organization.
It's a small organization.
The organization helps homeless children.

spanish.definition: Grupo de personas que trabajan juntas con un propósito.

definition: An important test at school.
examples: I have a math exam tomorrow.
She passed all her exams.
He's studying for his final exam.

spanish.definition: Prueba importante en la escuela.

definition: A small imaginary person with wings and magic powers.
examples: My daughter loves fairy tales.
She dressed as a fairy.
A good fairy helped the princess.

spanish.definition: Personaje imaginario pequeño con alas y magia.

definition: Something you say about a person or thing; to say this.
examples: Leave a comment below the video.
She made a rude comment.
He didn't comment on the news.

spanish.definition: Algo que dices sobre alguien o algo; decirlo.

definition: Something you do, especially for fun.
examples: Swimming is my favorite activity.
The camp has many activities for kids.
Police saw some strange activity on the street.

spanish.definition: Algo que haces, sobre todo para divertirte.

definition: The border around a picture or window; to put in a border.
examples: I bought a frame for this photo.
Her glasses have red frames.
He framed the picture and hung it up.

spanish.definition: Borde de un cuadro o una ventana; poner en un marco.

definition: A soldier on a horse in the old days; a piece in chess.
examples: The knight saved the princess.
He wore a knight's costume.
You can move your knight now.

spanish.definition: Soldado a caballo de otros tiempos; pieza de ajedrez.

definition: Something you do often, without thinking.
examples: Biting your nails is a bad habit.
I'm trying to change my eating habits.
She has a habit of being late.

spanish.definition: Algo que haces seguido, sin pensar.

definition: A place that protects you from bad weather or danger.
examples: We found shelter from the rain.
She got her dog from an animal shelter.
The homeless shelter was full.

spanish.definition: Lugar que protege del mal tiempo o del peligro.

definition: To move like water; steady movement.
examples: The river flows to the ocean.
Blood flows through our bodies.
The flow of traffic is slow today.

spanish.definition: Moverse como el agua; movimiento constante.

definition: To stop something from happening.
examples: Wash your hands to prevent illness.
Nothing could prevent the accident.
The rain prevented us from going out.

spanish.definition: Hacer que algo no pase.

definition: A small amount that shows what something is like.
examples: Try a free sample of this cheese.
The nurse took a blood sample.
She showed me a sample of her work.

spanish.definition: Cantidad pequeña que enseña cómo es algo.

definition: A long, thin piece; to take something off.
examples: Cut the paper into strips.
They stripped the walls and painted them.
We walked along a strip of sand.

spanish.definition: Pedazo largo y delgado; retirar algo.

definition: To make a low, steady sound like a bee; this sound.
examples: A fly was buzzing around my head.
My phone buzzed in my pocket.
I can hear a buzz from the radio.

spanish.definition: Hacer un sonido bajo y constante como una abeja; ese sonido.

definition: A religious man who lives in a group away from others.
examples: The monks get up at four.
He became a monk at thirty.
A monk showed us around the old church.

spanish.definition: Hombre religioso que vive en grupo apartado de los demás.

definition: A little.
examples: I'm slightly tired.
The price went up slightly.
She's slightly taller than me.

spanish.definition: Un poco.

definition: To make or grow something.
examples: This factory produces cars.
Brazil produces a lot of coffee.
She produced three movies last year.

spanish.definition: Hacer o cultivar algo.

definition: Making you a little angry.
examples: That noise is so annoying.
My little brother is really annoying.
It's annoying when people are late.

spanish.definition: Que te enoja un poco.

definition: Your ability to decide well; a decision in court.
examples: I trust your judgment.
The court gave its judgment on Friday.
He showed poor judgment.

spanish.definition: Capacidad de decidir bien; decisión en un tribunal.

definition: Clothes that need washing.
examples: I have to do the laundry.
Put your laundry in the basket.
This room smells like clean laundry.

spanish.definition: Ropa que hay que lavar.

definition: Very bad.
examples: The food here is lousy.
I feel lousy today.
What lousy weather!

spanish.definition: Muy malo.

definition: The fact of being real or alive.
examples: Do you believe in the existence of aliens?
The company has been in existence for fifty years.
The animal's existence is in danger.

spanish.definition: El hecho de ser real o estar vivo.

definition: Your stomach.
examples: My belly hurts.
The baby has a round belly.
He lay on his belly in the grass.

spanish.definition: Estómago.

definition: Taking care of a child who is not yours; to help something grow.
examples: She grew up with a foster family.
They fostered three children.
Teachers should foster a love of reading.

spanish.definition: Que cuida a un niño que no es suyo; ayudar a que algo crezca.

definition: A woman who acts in movies or plays.
examples: She's a famous actress.
Who's your favorite actress?
The actress won an Oscar.

spanish.definition: Mujer que actúa en películas u obras.

definition: One person; for one person or thing only.
examples: Every individual is different.
The teacher gives individual help.
The cookies come in individual bags.

spanish.definition: Una persona; para una sola persona o cosa.

definition: A picture drawn on your skin with a needle and ink.
examples: He has a tattoo on his arm.
I want to get a small tattoo.
The tattoo on her back is a small bird.

spanish.definition: Dibujo hecho en la piel con aguja y tinta.

definition: A wall of wood or wire around an area.
examples: The dog jumped over the fence.
We painted the fence white.
There's a tall fence around the garden.

spanish.definition: Pared de madera o alambre alrededor de un área.

definition: The bowl in a kitchen for washing; to go down under water.
examples: The dishes are in the sink.
The ship sank in two hours.
Rocks sink in water.

spanish.definition: Recipiente de la cocina para lavar; irse al fondo del agua.

definition: Loud, fast rock music; a rude young person.
examples: He played in a punk band.
I loved punk in high school.
Get out of here, you little punk!

spanish.definition: Rock fuerte y rápido; joven grosero.

definition: Sure about yourself or about something.
examples: She's a confident speaker.
I'm confident we can win.
He felt confident before the test.

spanish.definition: Seguro de ti mismo o de algo.

definition: Wrong about something.
examples: You're mistaken, that's not my car.
If I'm not mistaken, she's from Peru.
I was mistaken about the date.

spanish.definition: Que no tiene razón sobre algo.

definition: The most that is allowed or possible; to keep something small.
examples: The speed limit is sixty.
There's a limit to my patience.
Try to limit your sugar.

spanish.definition: Lo máximo permitido o posible; mantener algo pequeño.

definition: Not comfortable.
examples: This chair is uncomfortable.
I feel uncomfortable around him.
These shoes are really uncomfortable.

spanish.definition: Que no es cómodo.

definition: A man who works for the police.
examples: Ask that policeman for help.
A policeman stopped my car.
My uncle is a policeman.

spanish.definition: Hombre que trabaja en la policía.

definition: Exactly.
examples: The train left at precisely six.
That's precisely what I mean.
Tell me precisely what happened.

spanish.definition: Exactamente.

definition: Only.
examples: I was merely asking a question.
It's merely a cold.
She merely smiled and walked away.

spanish.definition: Solamente.

definition: Clothes you wear under your other clothes.
examples: I need new underwear.
Pack enough underwear for the trip.
He answered the door in his underwear.

spanish.definition: Ropa que se usa debajo de la demás.

definition: To show or tell something secret.
examples: She didn't reveal her age.
The photo revealed the truth.
He finally revealed his plan.

spanish.definition: Mostrar o contar algo secreto.

definition: The way a person usually thinks, feels, and acts.
examples: She has a great personality.
Their personalities are very different.
He's got a strong personality.

spanish.definition: Forma en que alguien suele pensar, sentir y actuar.

definition: The head of the Catholic Church.
examples: The pope lives in Rome.
Thousands of people came to see the pope.
The pope gave a speech at Christmas.

spanish.definition: Jefe de la Iglesia católica.

definition: Information about how to do something.
examples: Read the instructions first.
He gave me clear instructions.
Follow the instructions on the box.

spanish.definition: Información sobre cómo hacer algo.

definition: Able to learn and understand things quickly.
examples: She's a very intelligent girl.
Dolphins are intelligent animals.
He asked an intelligent question.

spanish.definition: Capaz de aprender y entender rápido.

definition: A strong effect; when one thing hits another.
examples: The news had a big impact on her.
The car was destroyed on impact.
Her teacher had a huge impact on her life.

spanish.definition: Efecto fuerte; cuando una cosa golpea a otra.

definition: To steal from a person or place.
examples: Two men robbed the bank.
I was robbed on the subway.
They tried to rob a store.

spanish.definition: Quitarle cosas a una persona o lugar.

definition: A good feeling when something bad ends; help.
examples: What a relief!
This cream gives quick relief from pain.
It was a relief to get home.

spanish.definition: Sensación buena cuando algo malo acaba; ayuda.

definition: A person who invites guests or leads a TV show; to do this.
examples: Our host made a big dinner.
He's the host of a game show.
We're hosting a party on Saturday.

spanish.definition: Persona que invita a otros o dirige un programa; hacerlo.

definition: Video of an event.
examples: The news showed footage of the fire.
We watched old footage of the team.
Police checked the security footage.

spanish.definition: Video de un suceso.

definition: How likely something is to happen.
examples: The odds of winning are very low.
What are the odds?
She beat the odds and survived.

spanish.definition: Qué tan probable es que algo pase.

definition: Going around an area to check it; to do this.
examples: Police patrol this street at night.
The soldiers were on patrol.
A patrol car stopped next to us.

spanish.definition: Recorrer un área para vigilarla; hacerlo.

definition: A show with clowns, animals, and people who do difficult tricks.
examples: We took the kids to the circus.
The circus comes to town every summer.
He ran away to join the circus.

spanish.definition: Espectáculo con payasos, animales y personas que hacen trucos difíciles.

definition: To catch a person or animal; the act of catching.
examples: The police captured the thief.
He took a photo to capture the moment.
The soldiers escaped capture.

spanish.definition: Atrapar a una persona o animal; acción de atrapar.

definition: A special event; a time when something happens.
examples: This wine is for a special occasion.
I've met him on several occasions.
Your birthday is a big occasion.

spanish.definition: Evento especial; momento en que pasa algo.

definition: The beat of your heart that you can feel in your wrist.
examples: The nurse checked my pulse.
His pulse is very weak.
She felt a fast pulse in her neck.

spanish.definition: Latido del corazón que se siente en la muñeca.

definition: To make something that did not exist before.
examples: Who invented the telephone?
She invented a new game.
He invented a story to explain it.

spanish.definition: Crear algo que no existía antes.

definition: A white or gray mass in the sky.
examples: There isn't a cloud in the sky.
Dark clouds came in from the west.
My photos are saved in the cloud.

spanish.definition: Masa blanca o gris en el cielo.

definition: Your name, written by you in a special way.
examples: I need your signature here.
Is this your signature?
I can't read the doctor's signature.

spanish.definition: Tu nombre, escrito por ti de una forma especial.

definition: To say you are not happy about something.
examples: Stop complaining about the food.
She complained to the manager.
He always complains about his job.

spanish.definition: Decir que no estás contento con algo.

definition: A computer screen; to watch something carefully.
examples: I need a bigger monitor.
The nurse monitored his heart.
We monitor the weather every day.

spanish.definition: Pantalla de computadora; observar algo con cuidado.

definition: To shout loudly; a loud shout.
examples: Don't yell at me!
He yelled for help.
She gave a yell of pain.

spanish.definition: Hablar muy fuerte; sonido muy fuerte de la voz.

definition: An animal like a big mouse.
examples: I saw a rat in the subway.
Rats carry disease.
There's a rat in the kitchen!

spanish.definition: Animal parecido a un ratón grande.

definition: Flat and soft, with no rough parts; without problems.
examples: Her skin is so smooth.
The road is nice and smooth here.
We had a smooth flight.

spanish.definition: Plano y suave, sin partes ásperas; sin problemas.

definition: To fight against something; to stop yourself from doing something.
examples: I couldn't resist the chocolate cake.
He didn't resist when the police came.
It's hard to resist a sale.

spanish.definition: Luchar contra algo; aguantarse de hacer algo.

definition: Something good that you imagine; stories with magic.
examples: He lives in a fantasy world.
She likes reading fantasy.
That trip was just a fantasy.

spanish.definition: Algo bueno que imaginas; historias con magia.

definition: An official book you need to travel to other countries.
examples: Don't forget your passport.
My passport expires next year.
Show your passport at the airport.

spanish.definition: Libreta oficial para viajar a otros países.

definition: How high a sound is; to throw a ball in baseball.
examples: He pitched for the Yankees.
She sang at a very high pitch.
Who's pitching tonight?

spanish.definition: Qué tan alto es un sonido; arrojar la pelota en béisbol.

definition: A tool for hitting nails; to hit with this tool.
examples: Hand me the hammer.
He hammered a nail into the wall.
I hit my thumb with a hammer.

spanish.definition: Herramienta para golpear clavos; golpear con ella.

definition: The crime of killing a person.
examples: She's a homicide detective.
He was arrested for homicide.
The police are calling it a homicide.

spanish.definition: Delito de matar a una persona.

definition: Twelve o'clock in the day.
examples: Let's meet at noon.
Lunch is served at noon.
She didn't wake up until noon.

spanish.definition: Las doce del día.

definition: An aircraft with big blades on top.
examples: A helicopter flew over our house.
They took him to the hospital by helicopter.
The police helicopter was looking for him.

spanish.definition: Aeronave con grandes aspas encima.

definition: To turn around quickly; a fast turn.
examples: The wheels spun on the ice.
My head is spinning.
Take the car for a spin.

spanish.definition: Dar vueltas rápido; giro rápido.

definition: A quality that makes people like you; to make people like you.
examples: He charmed everyone at the party.
This old town has a lot of charm.
She wears a lucky charm.

spanish.definition: Cualidad que hace que la gente te quiera; hacer que te quieran.

definition: To hit someone with an open hand; this kind of hit.
examples: She slapped him across the face.
He got a slap on the wrist.
Don't slap your brother!

spanish.definition: Golpear a alguien con la mano abierta; ese golpe.

definition: To ask for a job or a place; to put something on a surface.
examples: I applied for a job at the bank.
She applied to three colleges.
Apply this cream twice a day.

spanish.definition: Pedir un trabajo o un puesto; poner algo sobre una superficie.

definition: Coming before.
examples: She has two kids from a previous marriage.
Go back to the previous page.
He didn't work at his previous job for long.

spanish.definition: Que viene antes.

definition: A picture taken with a camera; to take this picture.
examples: This is an old photograph of my family.
She photographed the mountains.
May I take a photograph of you?

spanish.definition: Imagen tomada con una cámara; tomar esa imagen.

definition: Under.
examples: The river runs beneath the bridge.
We sat beneath a tree.
The ground moved beneath our feet.

spanish.definition: Abajo de.

definition: To speak for someone; to be a sign of something.
examples: A lawyer will represent you.
The stars on the flag represent the states.
She represents our team at the meeting.

spanish.definition: Hablar por alguien; ser señal de algo.

definition: Not able to hear.
examples: My grandfather is a little deaf.
She's been deaf since birth.
He teaches deaf children.

spanish.definition: Que no puede oír.

definition: A crime; something that upsets people; the attacking part of a team.
examples: No offense, but I don't like it.
It's his first offense.
Our team has a strong offense.

spanish.definition: Crimen; algo que molesta a la gente; parte de un equipo que ataca.

definition: A funny performer with a red nose.
examples: My son is afraid of clowns.
We hired a clown for the party.
The clown made the kids laugh.

spanish.definition: Artista cómico con nariz roja.

definition: To break with a sudden sound; to speak angrily; this sound.
examples: The branch snapped under his foot.
Sorry I snapped at you.
She closed her bag with a snap.

spanish.definition: Romperse con un ruido repentino; hablar con enojo; ese ruido.
